technical.summary: Strong overbought conditions with trending ADX and bullish structure, but momentum divergence (RSI not rising), price below key moving averages, and weak volume undermine conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ADSK shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 13 days present elevated volatility risk with no fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Weak bearish signal from junior representative selling small positions 80-98 days ago; neutral market sentiment and unavailable news data provide no confirmation or contradiction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (347), and CPI event just occurred; earnings in 13 days adds binary risk; falling DXY provides minor relief for multinational ADSK but insufficient to offset systemic stress.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 14 extreme overbought with strong ADX trend and price above Ichimoku cloud provide technical structure for mean-reversion bounce, especially near support at 224.43.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental vacuum (zero insider/institutional conviction), earnings binary risk in 13 days, macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 347, post-CPI), price below 50/200 EMAs, and momentum divergence (RSI 9 not rising) create asymmetric downside risk that overwhelms technical overbought setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical overbought (RSI 14) with strong ADX trend offers mean-reversion structure, but this is insufficient to justify entry given macro crisis and earnings binary risk.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 13 days combined with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (347), and zero fundamental conviction create asymmetric downside risk that overwhelms technical setup.
